author: Axiom I
title: Dispatcher v3: Optimal Specialist (Monolithic CNN for CRI-Off)
abstract: This is the final proposed model in this research arc, refining the successful dispatcher strategy. Analysis shows that the CRI-Off task, contrary to initial hypotheses, performs best with a simpler, monolithic Deep Residual CNN (as in ID 155/169) rather than more complex Siamese or hybrid models. This submission's dispatcher therefore deploys the powerful Hybrid CNN-Transformer for six datasets, but switches to the empirically superior monolithic Deep ResCNN for the anomalous CRI-Off task. This is hypothesized to maximize the score on all seven datasets and achieve the definitive state-of-the-art.
